# SmartCart frontend fixture

A small React and TypeScript repository used by RepoDocs tests. It contains a
React Router application with nested JSX routes and object routes, an axios
instance, fetch calls with literal, template, and dynamic URLs, a lazily loaded
page, a class component, a path-alias import that cannot be resolved, a JSX
apostrophe, an eval call, and test and build-configuration files that must be
ignored.
